{{nihongo|'''Yamato Onchi Shrine'''|倭恩智神社}} is a [[shinto shrine]] in the [[Engishiki Jinmyōchō]]. It is located in [[Yamato Province]].

'''Yamato Onchi Shrine''' (やまとおんちじんじゃ) is a {{ill|Shinto shrine|Q845945|qid=Q845945}} in {{ill|Tenri, Nara|ar|تيرني (نارا)|azb|تنری، نارا|ca|Tenri|ce|Тэнри|ceb|Tenri (lungsod sa Hapon)|de|Tenri|eo|Tenri|es|Tenri (Nara)|eu|Tenri (Nara)|fa|تنری، نارا|fi|Tenri|fr|Tenri|gl|Tenri|id|Tenri, Nara|it|Tenri|ja|天理市|ko|덴리시|mg|Tenri|mzn|تنری، نارا|nl|Tenri|pl|Tenri|pt|Tenri|ro|Tenri|ru|Тэнри|simple|Tenri, Nara|sv|Tenri, Nara|tg|Тенри|tl|Tenri, Nara|tr|Tenri|tt|Тэнри|uk|Тенрі|ur|ٹینری، نارا|vi|Tenri, Nara|war|Tenri, Nara|zh|天理市|zh_classical|天理市|zh_min_nan|Tenri-chhī|zh_yue|天理|qid=Q502196}}, {{ill|Nara Prefecture|Q131287|qid=Q131287}}. It is an {{ill|Engishiki Jinmyōchō|Q11064932|qid=Q11064932|lt=Shikinaisha (small shrine)}}, and its former shrine rank was {{ill|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|Q712534|Modern system of ranked Shinto shrines|lt=village shrine}}.

=== History ===
=== Foundation ===
Its foundation is said to date to year 7 of {{ill|Emperor Sujin|ar|الإمبراطور سوجين|arz|الامبراطور سوجين|azb|سوجین (ایمپیراتور)|ca|Sujin|ckb|ئیمپراتۆر سوجین|cs|Sudžin|de|Sujin|el|Αυτοκράτορας Σουτζίν|es|Sujin Tennō|fa|امپراتور سوجین|fr|Sujin|hr|Sujin|id|Kaisar Sujin|it|Sujin|ja|崇神天皇|ka|სუძინი|ko|스진 천황|ms|Maharaja Sujin|nl|Sujin|pl|Sujin|pt|Sujin|ru|Император Судзин|sh|Car Sujin|simple|Emperor Sujin|sl|Cesar Sudžin|sr|Суџин|sv|Sujin|th|จักรพรรดิซูจิง|tl|Emperador Sujin|tr|Sujin (imparator)|uk|Імператор Судзін|uz|Imperator Sujin|vi|Thiên hoàng Sujin|yo|Emperor Sujin|zh|崇神天皇|zh_classical|崇神天皇|zh_min_nan|Suzin Thian-hông|zh_yue|崇神天皇|qid=Q333530}}, and the ''Shiki-gunshi'' states that it enshrines the ancestor of the Yamato Onchi clan. The ''{{ill|Shinsen Shōjiroku|de|Shinsen Shōjiroku|fr|Shinsen shōjiroku|ja|新撰姓氏録|ko|신찬성씨록|ru|Синсэн сёдзироку|zh|新撰姓氏錄|qid=Q1045362}}'' records the name "Onchi-no-Miyatsuko" and states: "Yamato no Kambetsu Onchi-no-Miyatsuko are descendants in the 14th generation of Takenori-no-Mikoto, descendant of {{ill|UNKNOWN|lt=Amatsu-hikone-no-Mikoto}}." It is inferred that this shrine was where the Yamato Onchi clan enshrined their ancestral deity Takenori-no-Mikoto. There is also {{ill|Onji Shrine|ja|恩智神社|qid=Q11492258}} (an {{ill|Myōjin Taisha|fr|Myōjin Taisha|ja|名神大社|simple|Myōjin Taisha|zh|名神大社|qid=Q9610964}} listed in the Engishiki) in {{ill|Yao, Osaka|Q490872|qid=Q490872}}, {{ill|Osaka Prefecture|Q122723|qid=Q122723}} (former {{ill|Kawachi Province|be|Каваты (правінцыя)|ca|Província de Kawachi|ckb|پارێزگای کاواچی|cs|Provincie Kawači|de|Provinz Kawachi|es|Provincia de Kawachi|fa|ولایت کاواچی|fr|Province de Kawachi|gl|Provincia de Kawachi|hak|Kawachi-koet|id|Provinsi Kawachi|it|Kawachi (provincia)|ja|河内国|ko|가와치국|lt|Kavačio žemė|nl|Kawachi (provincie)|pt|Província de Kawachi|ru|Кавати (провинция)|simple|Kawachi Province|sk|Kawači (provincia)|sr|Провинција Кавачи|tr|Kawachi (vilayet)|uk|Провінція Каваті|zh|河內國|zh_min_nan|Kawati-kok|zh_yue|河內國|qid=Q1047150}}), bearing the same "Onchi" name, and a relationship has been suggested; however, that shrine has strong ties with the {{ill|Nakatomi clan|ar|ناكاتومي|de|Nakatomi (Klan)|el|Αδελφότητα Νακατόμι|es|Clan Nakatomi|fa|خاندان ناکاتومی|fr|Clan Nakatomi|it|Clan Nakatomi|ja|中臣氏|ko|나카토미씨|nl|Nakatomi-clan|pl|Nakatomi (ród)|pt|Clã Nakatomi|vi|Gia tộc Nakatomi|zh|中臣氏|qid=Q1198447}}, and its enshrined deity differs from that of this shrine.
